content_of_post_to_comment: I think you can make a not unreasonable argument that the great sorting of the 1990s/2000s that sucked lots of people who would have been local/regional/state level elites in decades past into global megacities has resulted in massive harms that no one seems to even be aware of/fully understand. I say that as someone who moved from NH to DC in 2009, but my parents (local elected official dad, teacher mom) very much fit this local activist concept.
comment: One overlooked cost may be the hollowing out of civic "middle layers": people who left local institutions also took away mentorship pipelines that helped communities reproduce leadership.
